description: This file defines a PHP class 'ViewModifySearch' that extends the SugarView framework class. It manages the display of a modification interface for search sources within the SuiteCRM Connectors module, including rendering templates and handling enabling/disabling of connector sources.

classes.name: ViewModifySearch
classes.description: A class extending SugarView responsible for rendering the modify search interface in the Connectors module, including filtering connector sources based on their enablement status and rendering a Smarty template.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns an array of HTML links and labels used to construct the module title for the view.

methods.name: _getModuleTab
methods.description: Returns the name of the module tab, here 'Administration'.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Handles the logic for displaying the modify search page, fetching connector sources, filtering them based on their availability, and rendering the template.
